Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) This tender pertains to: Deployment of Manpower for Running & Maintenance Work of Guest House/Transit Camp at 400/220 kV Pirana Substation through GeM for a Period of Two Years. 1. Bidders should go through the bidding document to ascertain their scope of work and quote their prices accordingly. 2. Bidder should have office in any of the states under Region WR-II as on date of original sche duled date of bid opening. Region shall constitute states of Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Maharas htra or UT of Daman, Diu and Dadra and Nagar Haveli. 3. Place of service shall be: As per GeM Consignee. 4. Buyer reserves the right to increase of decrease the quantity (as detailed in the BOQ) up to 25% of contra ct value. However individual item of BOQ may vary up to any extent. Note-2: In case bidder is a holding company, the Financial Position criteria referred to in clause 2 shall be o f that holding company only (i.e. excluding its subsidiary/group companies). In case bidder is a subsidiary o f a holding company, the Financial Position criteria referred to in clause 2 shall be of that subsidiary compa ny only (i.e. excluding its holding company). Note-3: Relaxation for Start-Ups^/ MSEs MSE bidders are exempted from financial qualification criteria (MAAT) subject to submission of valid UDYAM certificate. The bidder shall submit documentary evidence in support of meeting the qualification criteria as specified above. ***** End of QR*****
